points.quote: AI must not be used to generate assessed work unless explicitly permitted
points.gist: AI must not be used to generate assessed work unless explicitly permitted.
Where AI use is permitted, it must be clearly acknowledged.

points.quote: The nature and extent of AI use must be explained
points.gist: Where AI use is permitted, the nature and extent of the use must be explained.

points.quote: Reflections on the quality of AI outputs should be explored
points.gist: Where AI use is permitted, reflections on the quality of AI outputs should be explored.

points.quote: Unauthorised AI use in formal assessments may be considered as academic misconduct, depending on its use and advantage.
points.gist: Unauthorised AI use in formal assessments may count as academic misconduct, depending on its use and advantage.

points.quote: Sensitive, personal, or confidential data must not be entered into AI tools unless approved
points.gist: Sensitive, personal or confidential data must not be entered into AI tools unless approved.

points.quote: The use of AI to generate or substantially assist responses in live recruitment activities (including interviews, assessment centres, or timed tasks) is inappropriate unless explicitly permitted by the employer.
points.gist: Using AI to generate or substantially assist responses in live recruitment activities is inappropriate unless the employer explicitly permits it.

points.quote: AI may be used to support preparation activities (e.g. drafting CVs, interview practice, and labour market research), provided its use enhances understanding and does not replace the development of a student’s own skills and judgement.
points.gist: AI may support preparation such as drafting CVs or interview practice if it enhances understanding and does not replace the student's own skills.

points.quote: Students remain fully accountable for all AI-supported outputs and must be able to explain, justify, and critically evaluate any content they submit.
points.gist: Students remain accountable for AI-supported outputs and must be able to explain, justify and critically evaluate what they submit.

points.quote: Circumventing academic or professional integrity requirements.
points.gist: Circumventing academic or professional integrity requirements is strictly prohibited.

points.quote: Harassment, discrimination, or deceptive practices (e.g. deepfakes)
points.gist: Harassment, discrimination, or deceptive practices such as deepfakes are strictly prohibited.

points.quote: Any breaches will be treated seriously and addressed proportionately in line with established UCB procedures and applicable regulations.
points.gist: Breaches are treated seriously and addressed proportionately under established UCB procedures and applicable regulations.

points.quote: Staff and students should use AI tools proportionately and consider their energy and resource implications where practical.
points.gist: Staff and students should use AI tools proportionately and consider energy and resource implications where practical.

points.quote: The Learning and Teaching Strategy (2025–2030) positions AI capability as a core graduate outcome.
points.anchor: 3. UCB Approach to AI in Education
points.gist: The Learning and Teaching Strategy (2025–2030) positions AI capability as a core graduate outcome.
